Method of Attack: Typosquatting, Base64 obfuscation with ROT13 cipher, Mining Monero (XMR) cryptocurrency, Stealing AWS credentials
Attack Vector: The package is installed on the system, after which it exfiltrates IP address, operating system information, and sensitive data like AWS credentials. It also determines the operating system being used and loads a crypto miner from MoneroOcean's GitHub repository.
Indicators of Compromise: Exfiltration of Amazon AWS credentials present in ~/.aws/credentials
